thread:
Maria Nguyen: Quick sync — need to lock the rerank endpoint contract for hybrid scoring (model score + policy adjustments). Draft PR: https://go/redwood/rerank-contract-draft. Key open items: numeric score range, tie-breaker metadata, score_units for quota, and model-selection routing heuristics.

Jason Lee: +1 to normalizing to 0..1 on the API surface. Avoid leaking model internals. Expose raw_logit optional field behind a flag. For quota, map `score_units` = ceil(topk * scale) (proposal).

Kevin Choi: We should support two output modes: `normalized` and `raw`. Normalized: float 0-1. Raw: model-provided logits (floats might be >1). Also add `explain` blob for diagnostics (small). Example:```json
[{"id":"c1","score":0.87,"raw_logit":2.3,"explain":{"type":"tok_overlap","value":0.4}}]```

Sarah Ortiz: Telemetry requirements: we need model_id, quantization_profile, tokens_generated, and route_reason (why this model was chosen) in trace/span tags. Dashboards should surface p95 latency by model + topk and cost_units consumed per 1k requests.

Maria Nguyen: For tie-breakers: include deterministic tie_key optional string that callers can set; otherwise server uses model_affinity + stable hashing. That helps for caching and consistent reranks.

Jason Lee: On routing: prefer cheaper compatible model when cost cap set by tenant, but allow a forced model param to pin a model. If fallback happens, include `fallback_reason` and `fallback_chain` in the response meta.

Kevin Choi: Small nit — keep response shape compact to reduce network bytes for high-volume rerankers. Consider compressed `scores` array and optional `meta` only when non-empty. Example compact envelope:```json
{"scores":[{"id":"c1","s":0.87},{"id":"c2","s":0.12}],"meta":{"model":"m-reduce-v1","units":3}}```

Sarah Ortiz: Telemetry/metrics names proposal: `rerank.request.count`, `rerank.latency.p95`, `rerank.units.consumed`, tags: model, tenant, topk, route. Also emit an eval_event when scores distribution changes >5% vs baseline for regression alerts.

Maria Nguyen: UX for rollouts/canary — Console should show candidate model diff for small sample: mean score delta, top-1 swap rate, cost delta. Add `canary_id` and `canary_sample` in response when in canary mode.

Jason Lee: Security/quotas reminder: scoring endpoints should count units deterministically pre-response when possible (ceiling on tokens + topk). Avoid undercharging on retries.

Kevin Choi: Implementation blocker: some older models don't produce meaningful logits; we need a compatibility layer that maps their output to 0..1 using calibrated min-max per-model. That calibration data lives in model profiles.

Sarah Ortiz: Ops note — when fallback to cheaper model occurs, emit an event to the routing audit log with reason and original request id for debugging. Also surface these as a filterable column in the rerank dashboard.

Maria Nguyen: Action items: (1) Jason to draft API surface with normalized/raw modes + score_units calc. (2) Kevin to add compact envelope example + compatibility rules. (3) Sarah to list telemetry metrics + dashboard mockups. (4) I'll add canary fields and tie_key semantics to the PR. Ping me when you push updates. :thumbsup:

Jason Lee: I'll start the API doc edits now, will tag reviewers.

Kevin Choi: I'll sketch the compact serializer and perf numbers tomorrow.

Sarah Ortiz: Will add the metric names + alert thresholds to the PR.

Maria Nguyen: Perfect — thanks all. Let's aim to merge by end of week so Product can test the canary UX.
